description: Analyzes US real estate title and closing documents and returns a structured risk report: a risk score (0-100, higher is safer) and level, findings with verbatim evidence from the documents and guidance on how to cure each one, the Schedule B-I requirements extracted from any title commitment in the package, and the jurisdiction applied (jurisdictionApplied). Accepts one or more PDF documents as base64 strings (deed, title commitment, mortgage, closing disclosure, survey, payoff letter, HOA estoppel, etc.), including a single PDF containing a whole closing package, which is split into its constituent instruments. Submitting several documents together also enables cross-document checks for contradictions in parcel ID, address, and party names. Properties in all 50 states and DC are analyzed; statute citations appear only for jurisdictions at production maturity, so call check_coverage to see each state's maturity. Uses one of your 3 free analyses (sandbox tier) or 1 credit (paid tiers); call get_credit_balance first to confirm available credits.

documentsBase64.description: One or more PDF documents, each as a base64-encoded string.

name: analyze_title_documents
